definitions.explanation: A boy or young man with delicate, beautiful looks. The word stresses beauty and youth rather than ruggedness, and is also a stock character type in manga and anime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美少年|びしょうねん}だ。
⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{美少年|びしょうねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A beautiful young man appears in the manga.

examples.japanese: {子役|こやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美少年|びしょうねん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だった⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{渋|しぶ}い→渋い：06820_shibui⟧⟦{中年|ちゅうねん}→中年：11307_chuunen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: The actor, famous as a beautiful boy in his child-actor days, now wins fans playing rugged middle-aged roles.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美少女|びしょうじょ}→美少女：14337_bishoujo⟧: beautiful girl, the counterpart
- ⟦{美男子|びだんし}→美男子：17182_bidanshi⟧: handsome man (adult, slightly old-fashioned)
- ⟦イケメン→イケメン：04761_ikemen⟧: good-looking guy (everyday slang, any age)

USAGE:
In English the word is known as "bishōnen" from manga and anime, where it names the androgynous, slender pretty-boy type. In ordinary Japanese it simply describes a strikingly good-looking boy or teenager.
